Rams vs Broncos DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, September 27 · NFL Week 3 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of September 26, 10:33 AM ET

Matthew Stafford carries the highest SPAGS model projection in Sunday Night Football's Rams at Broncos DraftKings Showdown slate: 16.9 DraftKings points at a $10,400 FLEX salary, or 25.3 at captain for $15,600. Stafford holds the largest share of simulated winning-lineup credit at 76% across 10,000 simulations, and Kyren Williams holds the largest captain share at 19.7%.

Behind Stafford, the next four projections are Bo Nix (16.7, $10,000), Kyren Williams (16.1, $8,600), Davante Adams (12.0, $10,200) and Jaylen Waddle (10.7, $9,600). The Rams are a 2.5-point favorite in a game totaled at 44.5, with implied team totals of 21 for the Broncos and 23.5 for the Rams.

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the September 26, 10:33 AM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 10,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Kyren Williams, LAR RB ($8,600 FLEX / $12,900 CPT)

Kyren Williams holds 19.7% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $12,900 and the 16.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 24.2 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 14.4 carries and 3.6 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Williams averaged 16.1 points with a simulated floor of 6.0 and a ceiling of 31.6. He holds 68% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 19.7% as the captain and 48.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Matthew Stafford, LAR QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Matthew Stafford holds 17.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 16.9-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.3 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. Across 10,000 simulations Stafford averaged 17.0 points with a simulated floor of 6.6 and a ceiling of 30.9. He holds 76% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 17.5% as the captain and 58.3% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Bo Nix, DEN QB ($10,000 FLEX / $15,000 CPT)

Bo Nix holds 16.5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,000 and the 16.7-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.9 rushing attempts. Across 10,000 simulations Nix averaged 16.7 points with a simulated floor of 6.3 and a ceiling of 30.5. He holds 76% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 16.5% as the captain and 59.0% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Rams vs Broncos

Davante Adams, LAR WR ($10,200 FLEX / $15,300 CPT)

Davante Adams carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.0 DraftKings points for a $10,200 FLEX salary ($15,300 at captain). The model gives him 7.0 targets on 22.5 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Adams averaged 12.2 points with a simulated floor of 4.1 and a ceiling of 25.1. He holds 45% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.5% as the captain and 38.7% in a FLEX spot.

Jaylen Waddle carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 10.7 DraftKings points for a $9,600 FLEX salary ($14,400 at captain). The model gives him 6.4 targets on 26.0 routes. Across 10,000 simulations Waddle averaged 10.7 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 27.3. He holds 35% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 7.3% as the captain and 27.2% in a FLEX spot.

Blake Corum, LAR RB ($6,600 FLEX / $9,900 CPT)

Blake Corum carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.8 DraftKings points for a $6,600 FLEX salary ($9,900 at captain). The model gives him 12.4 carries and 1.1 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Corum averaged 10.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.5 and a ceiling of 24.4. He holds 30% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 6.5% as the captain and 23.8% in a FLEX spot.

J.K. Dobbins, DEN RB ($7,400 FLEX / $11,100 CPT)

J.K. Dobbins carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 9.0 DraftKings points for a $7,400 FLEX salary ($11,100 at captain). The model gives him 11.3 carries and 1.2 targets. Across 10,000 simulations Dobbins averaged 9.0 points with a simulated floor of 1.2 and a ceiling of 20.9. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.8% as the captain and 21.0% in a FLEX spot.

Across 10,000 simulations Engram averaged 6.3 points with a simulated floor of 1.6 and a ceiling of 14.6.
